purpose: Development and future training corpus for learning multi-step evidence gathering over AI-agent research. Disjoint from benchmark_pilot_v1.json.
selection_note: Selected from live Hugging Face paper search on 2026-09-12 for coverage of research agents, tool use, attribution, factuality, retrieval, and agent evaluation. Selection is curated, not exhaustive. Versions were resolved and downloaded from arXiv on 2026-09-13.
split_policy: These papers may be used for development and training examples. Never copy questions, grader notes, or papers reserved by data/research/benchmark_pilot_v1.json into training data.
